reviews.text: A lovely team, always attentive. The salon is great, and it even has a cabin for washing your dog yourself. I highly recommend it!
The animals are pampered and look beautiful.

A very good experience. You can tell the owners are passionate.
Ushka received a full grooming session.

Hello Vladimir Nuta,

Thank you so much for your wonderful 5-star rating. We are delighted that you enjoyed your experience at Etoile Canine - WashDog Paris.

Your satisfaction is our greatest reward, and we hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you back very soon.

See you soon,
The Etoile Canine - WashDog Paris Team
Besides being friendly, they are competent and take the time to do the haircut properly! I recommend them!
Fantastic! Great welcome, amazing dog! I highly recommend it!

Hello Sanata Vinicius,

A fantastic groomer! The welcome was very warm, and the whole team took great care of my Chow Chow puppy. The grooming was done with great care: he was beautifully styled, and every detail was perfect!

I also really appreciated receiving photos throughout the grooming process. At the end, the team sent me lots of photos and videos, which will remain wonderful memories. An excellent experience; I highly recommend it!

We've been going to Angelo and Maria for years for Spyke (a White Swiss Shepherd).
Their work always meets our expectations, not to mention the tenderness they show our dog.
Thank you for everything!
